description.value: This clippable light source uses batteries with 36 hours of run time. It also has a collapsible hand crank, which can recharge the light for 10 minutes of run time with 1 minute of turning. The chassis is constructed with both clips and magnetic attachments, allowing it to be worn on the shoulder or helmet, attached to a firearm, or carried in hand. The flashlight shines in a cone up to 10m per tech level (20m for standard issue Tau’ri flashlights).
